desc:
💧 YOU'RE TRAPPED IN A FACILITY... AND YOU HAVE TO DRAIN A TINY WATER TANK TO ESCAPE?!?!

🏢 You wake up inside a mysterious facility...
🚪 The exit is LOCKED, and somehow, EMPTYING THE WATER is your only way out.

🪣 Use ridiculous tools to drain the water
💰 Earn money & buy powerful upgrades
🤖 Unlock robots, pumps & crazy machines to help you
🐤 Get funny helpers to drain water automatically
🔓 Discover secrets hidden around the facility
🏆 Earn Badges & compete on Leaderboards

👀 But... why is an entire facility protecting a tiny tank of water?

⏰ Average playtime: 30+ minutes

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to support the game!

🔍 Tags: incremental, simulator, clicking, water, escape, funny, automation, upgrades, tycoon, idle, adventure, secrets
